newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Sao Paulo industrial firms sack 2,835 on Dec 2-7.
newsitem.headline: Sao Paulo industrial firms sack 2,835 on Dec 2-7.

text.p: Private industrial firms located in Sao Paulo state laid off 2,835 employees between Dec 2 and Dec 7, the Sao Paulo State Industries Federation (Fiesp) said in a statement.
In the previous week, Sao Paulo's industries sacked 2,290 workers.
Eighteen out of the 46 sectors included in the survey sacked personnel in the period. Six hired new people and 22 maintained their staff unchanged.
So far this year, Sao Paulo industries have laid off 170,391 workers or 7.99 percent of the Sao Paulo's industrial workforce.
In the last 12 months, Sao Paulo firms have sacked 191,705 workers, or 8.80 percent of Sao Paulo's industrial workforce, it added.
